finding: Deep-copying the constructor input protects against mutations of the original dictionary, but the public instance registry remains mutable. A changed path can be read under the old module label.
hypothesis: Pin the initial canonical registry and operation configuration; use an operation-local snapshot, reject in-place drift before or during observation, and preserve the exact initial path-to-source binding.
scope: Direct HelperRetrieval registry integrity; JobBoundRetrieval already checks its helper registry at entry.
controls: In-place source hash/path mutation before call
Duplicate cache lookup under mutated registry
Original constructor dictionary mutation remains harmless
Explicit newly constructed valid registry still works
not_a_claim: No protection against arbitrary trusted Python code that can rewrite private state, monkeypatch executors or falsify the journal.
